svg.aria-label: Sable: The shell that asks first. SSH in, type English, and Sable plans the work, previews every command, gates anything destructive behind a typed YES, hands long jobs to sandboxed sub-agents, and turns repeated work into reusable skills. Ollama, OpenAI or Anthropic. Zero LLM gateways.
